primary_question.question: Why is my Kebab too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not leave dry spice pockets in the bowl

related_questions.question: Why is my Kebab turning out soggy?
evidence: Do not marinate too long with lots of lemon flavor or the surface can turn mushy

related_questions.question: How can I improve my Kebab?
evidence: Do not leave raw chicken sitting at room temperature for long
Do not cut pieces too large or the outside may char before the center cooks
Do not leave large chunks, as they can burn on the kebabs
Do not leave dry spice pockets in the bowl
Do not add extra liquid or the marinade will slide off
